experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Mass spectrometry analysis of insoluble proteome from 5xFAD/Mdk-KO mouse brain. This study examines the insoluble protein fraction, focusing on aggregation-prone proteins including Aβ and its associated proteins.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: FAD/Mdk−/− (FAD/KO) mice were generated by crossing with FAD/Mdk+/− with Mdk+/− mice.

number_of_fractions.evidence: The pooled peptides were resolved by basic pH reverse phase LC on an XBridge C18 column (3.5 μm beads, 4.6 mm × 25 cm, Waters; buffer A: 10 mM ammonium formate, pH 8.0; buffer B: 95% acetonitrile, 10 mM ammonium formate, pH 8.0, ~2 h gradient, 40-concatenated fractions collected).

number_of_technical_replicates.evidence: All samples were analyzed in technical triplicates.

technology_type.evidence: We used an optimized protocol of TMT-LC/LC-MS/MS for deep proteome profiling.
